senses.gloss:
m. (-खः)
A plant, (Galedupa arborea.)
f. (-खा)
1 A branch, the branch of a tree.
2 A branch or subdivision of the Vedas, consisting of the several Saṃhitās or collections of prayers in each Veda, as received in different schools, modified more or less either in the arrangement of the whole text, or in particular portions of it.
3 An arm.
4 A sect, a faction, a party.
5 Any subdivision.
6 Any part of an animal not endowed with sensibility, as a horn, &c.
E.
शाख to pervade, aff. अच्.

n. (-रं)
A suburb.
E.
शाखा a branch or subdivision, and नगर a city.

n. (-रं)
A suburb.
E.
शाखा a branch, and पुर a city.

m. (-दः)
Difference of school or doctrine.
E.
शाखा, and भेद difference.

m. (-गः)
1 A monkey, an ape.
2 A squirrel.
E.
शाखा the branch of a tree, and मृग a deer.

m. (-ण्डः)
A Brahman who has changed his Śākhā or peculiar school of the Vedas for another.
E.
शाखा a branch of the Vedas, रम to sport, ड aff.

f. (-फा)
A root proceeding from a branch, as in the Indian fig, the branches of which shoot downwards to the ground and take fresh root there.
E.
शाखा a branch, and शिफा a fibrous root.

mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि)
Branched, branching, having branches, (literally or figuratively.)
m. (-खी)
1 A tree.
2 A Veda.
3 An inhabitant of the northern districts bordering on India, [] a Turk or Tartar.
4 The name of a king.
E.
शाखा a branch, aff. इनि.

m. (-टः)
A small tree, (Trophis aspera); also with कन् added शाखोटकः.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
Branching, ramifying.
E.
शाखा a branch, (literally or figuratively,) and य aff.

n. (-ख्यं)
Friendship.
m. (-ख्यः)
A friend.
E.
सखि a friend, य aff. of the property or pleonasm.

n. (-ख्यं)
Friendship.
E.
सखि a friend, यञ् aff.

m. (-सखा)
1 A friend.
2 An associate, a companion.
f. (-खी)
A woman's female friend or companion, a confidante, &c.
E.
स for समान all, (the world,) ख्या to celebrate, aff. इन्, and ङीष् fem. aff.; the masc. noun is irregularly inflected.

n. (-त्वं)
Friendship.
E.
सखि a friend, and त्व aff.; also सखिता.

n. (-नं)
A female friend or confidante.
E.
सखी, and जन a person.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Friendly, amicable.
E.
सखि a friend, ढञ् aff.
